summary: Verified new lead-capture wiring for Konsultasi/Karir/Kontak + Brosur, admin submissions listing, whitelist rejection, and KerjasamaPage visual regression. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass (POST /api/submissions/{konsultasi|karir|kontak|brosur} return {ok:true,id}; other_random -> 400; admin GET /api/admin/submissions?type=konsultasi returns created record with correct type & payload). Frontend: All 3 form submit buttons (data-testid konsultasi-submit-button, karir-submit-button, kontak-submit-button) successfully POST to backend, show Indonesian success message, and open new tab to https://wa.me/6285119833362 (redirects to api.whatsapp.com) with correct pre-filled text including user name and, for Karir, the position name (Full-Stack Developer, Talent Pool). Both 'Lamar Sekarang' and 'Daftar Talent Pool' dialogs submit successfully. KerjasamaPage: 'CERITA MEREKA' and final 'Ayo tumbuh bersama Huniaja.com' sections confirmed rendered with class bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 (light gray, readable).
critical_code_review_comments: publicApi.submitLead throws on non-2xx allowing UI to show error state - good. UI already handles loading/error/success.
KerjasamaPage bg change is correctly applied via Tailwind class bg-slate-100 on both target sections (line ~377 Partner Stories and ~589 Final CTA).
WA_URL uses wa.me/6285119833362 (correct per +62 851-1983-3362). Browser follows wa.me -> api.whatsapp.com redirect which is expected.
seed_data_creation: Test submissions with name prefix 'TEST_' inserted into `submissions` collection (konsultasi/karir/kontak/brosur). Not cleaned - harmless test rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend submissions whitelist = {konsultasi, karir, kontak, brosur}. WA number constant lives in ChatWidget.jsx (WA_NUMBER=6285119833362, WA_URL(msg)). Success indicators to look for: 'Terima kasih' (konsultasi/kontak) and 'Lamaran terkirim' (karir). Popup opened via window.open - Playwright captures via context 'page' event.
